name: window_trim
description: Window surround v2 (窗套+纵深细节): the V1 decorative ring (jambs + header + sill rows, projection 0/1, corner_material) plus cheap-depth moves — recess (glass set INTO the wall), protruding sill ledge, lintel. Default combo = recess+sill. shutters/flowerbox 已下线(活板门全线禁用, 实测 AI 用不明白)。方向状态全部派生, 禁止手改。
when_to_use: Around every window the style card wants a surround for (see details.depth.window_trim). Run AFTER arch_window.py: origin = bottom-left cell of the OPENING as seen from outside (same convention as arch_window). Opening sizes from 实测: medieval 1x2 / modern 2x3, sill 1-2 above ground (stats_detail_elements §2).
use_for: 治'窗户=一圈环'的纸糊细节: 玻璃内凹+窗台出挑是成本最低的纵深; 窗楣可选; 现代幕墙 = recess:0 + glass 满铺 + sill:false

origin.notes: bottom-left cell of the window opening, seen from outside

facing.notes: outward direction of the wall face

projection.notes: 0 = flush in the wall plane, 1 = sticks out of the face

material.notes: ring material from the style card

corner_material.notes: the 4 ring corners (角件); empty = same as ring

sill_material.notes: V1: ring bottom row override (slabs get type=bottom). V2: also the sill-ledge material when set; empty ledge = minecraft:stone_brick_slab

recess.notes: 玻璃内凹深度(格): 0=与墙齐平(仅幕墙), 1=标准纵深, 2=厚墙; recess=2 会自动打通深度1的隧道格(air)

glass_material.notes: 窗洞填充; ""=不放玻璃(回到V1纯环), minecraft:air=不上釉箭缝(显式air格), 幕墙用 minecraft:glass

sill.notes: 窗台: 窗洞下沿外贴1格(下半砖/倒放楼梯), 宽=洞口+2; projection=1时覆盖环底排同格

lintel.notes: 窗楣: 窗顶外贴1格收边条, 宽=洞口+2

lintel_material.notes: ""=minecraft:stone_brick_slab; *_slab→下半砖, *_stairs→倒放楼梯, 其他=整方块

pitfalls: recess 把玻璃放进墙体内侧: 1×1 窗洞+recess 时单块玻璃四邻无靠(support_check 会报悬浮), 1×1 箭缝窗用 recess=0
recess=2 会在玻璃前打通 1 格隧道(air 格), 没有 place_air 能力时先手工挖掉对应墙体格
方向状态全部由脚本推导, 禁止手改输出 JSON 里的 facing/half/open
活板门全线禁用(2026-08-07): 别在任何地方徒手/生成使用 trapdoor
